customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of excellent quality, with straightforward installation and easy-to-use features. Moreover, the device provides comprehensive security features, including an anti-pry/tamper alarm, and customers appreciate its stylish appearance. Additionally, they value the support from the Lavna team and find it convenient to use.

reviews.author: Rishabh
reviews.title: Great and highly effective locks
reviews.body: Using the lock for the last 2 years. They are easy to use, efficient and working great. Any technical issue is promptly resolved over video call and/or in-person support.

reviews.author: Atul Sharma
reviews.title: Worst after service and product
reviews.body: I really wanted to support Indian brands, so that is why I chose Lavna, and I trust that was my biggest mistake. First, for installation, they took more than two weeks. After installation, I thought my life was sorted, but not even three weeks later, the lock started causing issues. I highlighted the issue to the support team and mentioned that since it is my main door lock, if I get locked out because of a motor issue, I would need to break the door. reviews.author: ankit
reviews.title: Great lock
reviews.body: The lock is working perfectly fine. the team is very supportive. I talked to Jatin regarding the installation, and everything was cleared up very beautifully for me.

reviews.author: Rajeev Nair
reviews.title: Great digital lock solution
reviews.body: Really great performance. Works really well for us. Quick installation and exhaustive features. Speak appearance. Finger recognition works smooth. Secure solution.

reviews.author: Sai
reviews.title: Great lock and great support from Lavna team
reviews.body: Really good smart lock! It works well and has a lot of features that can keep your house safe. The customer support is really responsive and they helped me go inside my house when the battery died, All in a simple video call! Special thanks to Jatin who handles the LA44 model support, He instructed me every step of way to reset locks, use emergency power ports, etc.
